authorization: The exact 2014-2020 union reproduced 2,497 completed trades, more than 50 in every year, 4.4309% pooled mean net return, positive median, and 8.09% severe-loss incidence before this later-period challenge was started.

stage_a.requirement: Freeze all signal identities and all post-signal acceptance decisions before attaching any trade exit or return outcome.
stage_a.bull: Rebuild the exact quiet-inventory mother and dual-demand admission for 2024; reproduce the 2023 frozen candidate identity exactly; use the frozen 2022-2023 V24 identities; then apply the exact V19R2 next-market-session acceptance rule. Acceptance changes decision time and is not an outcome label.
stage_a.bear_fast: Use exact already-frozen V13R1 selected identities for 2022-2023. For 2024 use the outcome-blind V17-reproduced V10 raw candidate identity, retain exact V13R1 rank inputs, and defer capacity selection until executable paths exist.
stage_a.bear_slow: Rebuild the exact slow-supply-exhaustion mother with the same prior-session windows, raw-occurrence twenty-market-session cooldown, causal BEAR route, and no outcome-derived condition.

market_state.definition: BULL when completed cross-sectional median ret20 and ret60 are both greater than zero and both positive-return shares exceed 0.50; BEAR when both medians are at most zero and both positive shares are at most 0.50; otherwise TRANSITION.
market_state.availability: Signal-session close, using only completed current/prior observations available by that close.
market_state.2024: Exact already-frozen causal reconstruction whose 2023 regime labels reproduce the registered state with zero mismatches.

bull_quiet_inventory.mother: Exact sixty-session quiet-inventory mother: prior history and coordinate lineage valid; prior forty-session platform width <=30%; recent twenty-session mean turnover <= preceding forty-session mean; opening gap 1%-8%; close above frozen platform high; turnover >=1.5x prior-twenty mean; close location >=70%; non-upper-limit close.
bull_quiet_inventory.base_route: Causal BULL and PIT-industry median ret20 >0 and industry positive-ret20 share >0.50.
bull_quiet_inventory.dual_demand: Synchronized lane when same-day market and industry median returns are positive and both positive-return shares exceed 0.50. Otherwise idiosyncratic lane requires opening gap >=2% and stock same-day return at least 2 percentage points above PIT-industry median.
bull_quiet_inventory.acceptance: On exact next market session, synchronized lane close remains at/above frozen platform high; idiosyncratic lane close remains at/above both platform high and signal close.
bull_quiet_inventory.execution: First legal buyable open in signal sessions t+2 through t+4, +15% target after entry, H15 next legal open, no stop, 40 bp round trip.

bear_fast_capitulation.signal: Exact OAI: completed ret20 <=-10%, signal return >=5%, close above prior-five high, signal turnover >= prior-twenty mean, close location >=70%, non-upper-limit, twenty-session raw occurrence cooldown; plus prior-ten return <=-8%, causal BEAR, and positive-ret20 breadth above its value five completed market sessions earlier.
bear_fast_capitulation.capacity: Exact V13R1 ranking: higher stock-minus-industry ret20, higher close-versus-prior-ten high, higher close location, event id; K75 per sleeve, at most twenty new entries per sleeve/date, one active position per symbol.
bear_fast_capitulation.execution: First legal buyable open in t+1 through t+3, +10% target after entry, H20 next legal open, no stop, 40 bp round trip.

bear_slow_exhaustion.signal: Exact frozen slow-supply-exhaustion mother: causal BEAR; prior-twenty return <=-8%; latest-five low no lower than preceding-five low; latest-five downside turnover no greater than preceding-five; signal return 2%-7%; close location >=75%; close above prior-five high; turnover 1.0x-2.5x prior-twenty median; twenty-session raw occurrence cooldown.
bear_slow_exhaustion.execution: First legal buyable open in t+1 through t+3, +10% target after entry, H20 next legal open, no stop, 40 bp round trip.

union.route: BULL uses only the quiet-inventory component; BEAR uses the two repair components; TRANSITION holds cash.
union.deduplication: For the same symbol and signal date, keep Bull/fast-Bear before slow-Bear, then event id. Priority is frozen and not selected by payoff.

evaluation.primary: Completed event-level trade economics by signal year and pooled.
evaluation.written_gate: More than 50 completed signals in each of 2022, 2023 and 2024; pooled mean net return strictly above 4%; pooled median positive; severe-loss incidence <=20%.
evaluation.strict_stability_diagnostic: Also report whether each individual validation-year mean net return exceeds 4% and the number of independent signal dates.
